info.title: Vero (Secure Document Vault) Ingestion API
info.description: The contract for sending systems: create a submission, upload its PDFs, read their state. Sign-in is an OAuth2 client-credentials token from the customer's sign-in server; the tenant and the sending system come from the verified token, never from a request header. Every error has the same body (Error) with a stable code. Each answer below says whether to send the request again (x-sdv-retry). The versioning policy, the sender's guide and the changelog are in docs/api/README.md. The build checks this file against the running API (IngestionContractTest).

get.description: No sign-in needed. 200 with status UP: Vero can take work; send. 503: Vero can't take work right now (its database or the sign-in server can't be reached, its database is being upgraded, or no database connection has been free for 2 seconds because Vero is busy). Wait and ask again; a 503 here is never a refusal of anything you sent. Ask at most every few seconds.

503.description: Not ready. Wait and ask again; don't send meanwhile.

post.summary: Create a submission, or answer a retry of one
post.description: Creates the submission that the documents are then uploaded to. A retry with the same sourceSubmissionId and exactly the same body is answered 200 with the same submission (idempotentReplay true); a retry with a different body is refused (409).

201.description: Created. Upload the documents to submissionId.

200.description: Already received: a retry of the same request. The same submission, idempotentReplay true. Treat it as created.

400.description: Refused: the request is not valid. Nothing was created. Don't send it again unchanged; correct what the message names.

example.message: recordSensitivityLevel must be one of STANDARD, CONFIDENTIAL, HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL (exactly, in capitals); leave it out for no record level.

409.description: Refused: a submission with this sourceSubmissionId already exists with a different body. Nothing was changed. Don't send it again unchanged; repeat the first request exactly, or use a new sourceSubmissionId.

500.description: Failed inside Vero. Nothing was created. SDV-SYS-013 and SDV-SYS-017: send it again later. SDV-SYS-016 and SDV-INT-010: keep it and send it again once Vero's IT team has fixed the cause.

get.summary: Find a submission by your own sourceSubmissionId

parameters.name: sourceSubmissionId
parameters.description: The sourceSubmissionId the submission was created with.

400.description: Refused: the parameter is missing, blank or longer than 200 characters. Don't send it again unchanged.

get.summary: Read a submission and its progress

post.summary: Upload one PDF to a submission
post.description: One PDF per request, as the raw body. Name the document with X-SDV-Source-Document-Id (required when the submission listed all its documents) or, without one, Idempotency-Key. After a timeout or a lost answer, send exactly the same upload again with the same identity: Vero answers 200 and stores nothing twice.

parameters.name: X-SDV-Filename
parameters.description: The file name to show, without a path (no / or \, no control characters). Missing: 400 SDV-SYS-015; blank, too long or a path: 400 SDV-INT-013.

parameters.name: X-SDV-Source-Document-Id
parameters.description: Your stable ID for this document. Required when the submission listed all its documents (expectedDocuments has expectedDocumentCount entries); it must then be one of them (SDV-INT-012).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Names the upload when there is no X-SDV-Source-Document-Id. One of the two is required (SDV-INT-012). Reuse it for a retry.

parameters.name: X-SDV-Sensitivity-Level
parameters.description: The document's own level. Leave it out for STANDARD. Any other value, also a blank, lower-case or mixed-case one, is refused (400 SDV-SEN-001). A retry must send the same level as the first upload (409 SDV-SEN-003).

parameters.name: X-SDV-Record-Sensitivity-Level
parameters.description: Not accepted here: any value is refused (400 SDV-SEN-005). Send the record level as recordSensitivityLevel on the submission.

requestBody.description: The PDF itself. Content-Type must be application/pdf; other types get 415 SDV-SYS-015. Send Content-Length: a declared length over the limit is refused before the body is read.

200.description: Nothing new stored, and that is success; don't send it again. Either already received (a retry of the same upload: receiptAcknowledgement RECEIVED, idempotentReplay true) or DUPLICATE_ALREADY_STORED (the same file, same SHA-256, from this sending system for the same record in a new delivery: duplicate true, documentId is the document Vero already has).

400.description: Refused: the upload is not valid. Nothing was stored. Don't send it again unchanged; correct what the message names. SDV-INT-016 here: the document would take the submission over its total size limit; send it on a new submission.

example.message: X-SDV-Sensitivity-Level must be one of STANDARD, CONFIDENTIAL, HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL (exactly, in capitals); leave it out for STANDARD.

409.description: Refused. Nothing was stored. SDV-INT-016: the submission already has all its documents; send it on a new submission. SDV-INT-017, SDV-SEN-003: a document with this identity is already stored with other content, file name or level; repeat the first upload exactly, or use a new identity.

413.description: Refused: the PDF is larger than the limit for the tenant or the sending system; the message gives the limit in bytes. Nothing was stored. Don't send it again unchanged.

503.description: Vero can't take the upload right now. Nothing was stored. SDV-SYS-018: Vero is busy; wait the seconds in the Retry-After header and send the same upload again. Every other code here means unavailable and has no Retry-After: SDV-SYS-001, SDV-SYS-002, SDV-SYS-014, SDV-AUT-004 and SDV-STO-001 (Vero's storage is full): wait with back-off (check readiness) and send the same upload again. SDV-STO-004: storage for this tenant isn't available; the installer must fix it; keep the document and send it again after the fix.

get.summary: List the documents received for a submission

post.description: For a document whose status is PROCESSING_FAILED (or RECEIVED): Vero checks the stored file again and makes it AVAILABLE. An AVAILABLE document is answered as it is. The answer is the document's state afterwards; a failed check is shown there (status PROCESSING_FAILED, processingErrorCode), not as an error.

200.description: The document's state after the attempt.

404.description: Refused: no document of this submission has this ID. Don't send it again unchanged.

409.description: Refused: the document is in a state that can't be finished again (the message names it, for example PROCESSING). Don't send it again unchanged; read the document's state first.

bearerAuth.description: An OAuth2 client-credentials access token (a signed JWT) from the customer's sign-in server, one client per sending system. Vero checks: the signature against the server's published keys; iss equals Vero's SDV_AUTH_JWT_ISSUER; aud contains SDV_AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE; exp and nbf (and, when SDV_AUTH_JWT_MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME_SECONDS is set, exp minus iat at most that). Claims a sending system's token must carry: sub (the client's ID, 1 to 300 characters); the tenant-ID claim (SDV_AUTH_JWT_TENANT_CLAIM, default sdv_tenant_id) with the tenant's UUID; the source-ID claim (SDV_AUTH_JWT_SOURCE_ID_CLAIM, default sdv_source_id) with the sending system's UUID; both claims as JSON strings of at most 100 characters. It must not carry the groups claim (SDV_AUTH_JWT_GROUPS_CLAIM). The source-ID claim is what makes a token a sending system's: without it the token is read as a person's sign-in (see x-sdv-sign-in-answers). A planned change (the entity and sending system found from the client ID, before the first customer install) is described in docs/api/README.md.

x-sdv-required-claims.aud: Contains SDV_AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE. Missing or wrong: 401 SDV-AUT-003.
x-sdv-required-claims.exp: In the future (and nbf, when present, in the past). Expired: 401 SDV-AUT-003.
x-sdv-required-claims.sub: The client's ID, 1 to 300 characters. Missing or too long: 401 SDV-AUT-005.
x-sdv-required-claims.sdv_tenant_id: The tenant-ID claim (name set by SDV_AUTH_JWT_TENANT_CLAIM): the tenant's UUID as a string. Missing, not a string, too long or not a UUID: 401 SDV-AUT-005. A tenant Vero doesn't have, or a suspended one: 403 SDV-AUT-009.
x-sdv-required-claims.sdv_source_id: The source-ID claim (name set by SDV_AUTH_JWT_SOURCE_ID_CLAIM): the sending system's UUID as a string. Not a string, too long or not a UUID: 401 SDV-AUT-005. Missing or blank: the token is read as a person's (401 SDV-AUT-006 or SDV-AUT-007, or 403 SDV-AUT-002). A sending system that isn't the tenant's, or is paused: 403 SDV-INT-005.

x-sdv-sign-in-answers.case: Token expired, not yet valid, wrong signature, wrong issuer, wrong audience, lifetime too long, not a JWT, or an Authorization header that isn't 'Bearer <token>'
sub missing or too long; tenant-ID claim missing or not a UUID; source-ID claim not a UUID; both the source-ID claim and the groups claim present
No source-ID claim and Vero has no active sign-in connection for the issuer (read as a person)
No source-ID claim and no Vero role from the groups (read as a person)
A person's sign-in with a Vero role
Sending system not the tenant's, or paused
The sign-in server's keys can't be fetched
Sign-in is switched off in this Vero (SDV_AUTH_MODE=disabled)

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Your ID for this request, for tracing. Vero uses it as the answer's reference and returns it in the X-Correlation-Id answer header. A value that doesn't match the pattern is replaced by a new UUID (not refused).

SubmissionId.name: submissionId
SubmissionId.description: The submissionId Vero returned when the submission was created. Not a UUID: 400 SDV-SYS-015.

DocumentId.name: documentId
DocumentId.description: The documentId Vero returned for the upload. Not a UUID: 400 SDV-SYS-015.

CorrelationId.description: The request's reference: the X-Correlation-Id you sent, or one Vero made. The same value as reference in an error body.

RetryAfter.description: Only on the busy answer (503 SDV-SYS-018): the seconds to wait before sending the same request again, a whole number from 1 to 300 (5 unless the installer set it). Read the header; don't rely on the number. No other answer from Vero carries it.

status.description: UP: send. NOT_READY, OUT_OF_SERVICE or DOWN: wait. Other values may be added; anything but UP means wait.

ScalarMetadataValue.description: One JSON value: a string, a number or true/false. null, an object or a list is refused (400 SDV-INT-008).

CreateSubmissionRequest.description: Fields Vero doesn't know are ignored today. Send only the fields below. sensitivityLevel is refused (400 SDV-SEN-006): a document's level goes on its upload.

sourceSubmissionId.description: Your stable ID for this submission. A retry sends the same one.

expectedDocumentCount.description: How many documents will be uploaded. At most the tenant's or the sending system's limit (400 SDV-INT-007).

expectedDocuments.description: Optional list of the documents to come, by your sourceDocumentId; at most expectedDocumentCount entries. A complete list (expectedDocumentCount entries) makes X-SDV-Source-Document-Id required on each upload.

metadata.description: The fields Tenant IT set up for this sending system, by key. Unknown keys and missing required fields are refused (400 SDV-INT-008); a value that breaks its field's rule too (400 SDV-INT-009).

recordSensitivityLevel.description: Optional level for the whole record this submission belongs to (the submissions of this sending system with the same identifier values). Sets the record's first level or raises it; a lower or equal value is ignored and audited, not refused. Not exactly one of the names, also blank, lower case or not a string: 400 SDV-SEN-002. A retry must send the same value or none as the first: 409 SDV-SEN-004.

DocumentState.description: A document's state. AVAILABLE is done. RECEIVING, RECEIVED and PROCESSING are on the way. PROCESSING_FAILED: send retry-finalization. REDACTION_PROCESSING, RETENTION_DELETING and EXPIRED_DELETED are Vero's own later work. New states may be added; treat an unknown one as on the way.

submissionId.description: Vero's ID for the submission. Use it for the uploads.

sourceId.description: The sending system, from the token.

metadata.description: The values as Vero stored them, as text.

idempotentReplay.description: True when this answer is for a retry of an earlier create.

documentId.description: The stored document. For DUPLICATE_ALREADY_STORED, the document Vero already had (it may belong to an earlier submission).

sourceDocumentId.description: The X-SDV-Source-Document-Id this upload was sent with.

receiptAcknowledgement.description: RECEIVED: stored (201), or a retry of a stored upload (200). DUPLICATE_ALREADY_STORED: an exact duplicate; nothing was stored again (200).

idempotentReplay.description: True for a retry of the same upload (same X-SDV-Source-Document-Id, or Idempotency-Key when there is none), also of one that was an exact duplicate.

exactDuplicateContent.description: Same value as duplicate; kept for senders that read it.

SensitivityLevel.description: How sensitive a document is, from lowest to highest. Exactly these names, in capitals.

processingErrorCode.description: Why the last finishing failed, when status is PROCESSING_FAILED: DURABLE_OBJECT_VALIDATION_FAILED, STORAGE_SECURITY_VALIDATION_FAILED or DOCUMENT_FINALIZATION_FAILED.

code.description: A stable SDV-AREA-NNN code (docs/api/error-codes.md). Read the code, not the message.

message.description: A plain sentence for people. May be reworded. It never holds a stack trace, a token or document content.

reference.description: The request's reference, the same as the X-Correlation-Id answer header and Vero's log line. Give it to support.

BadRequestShape.description: Refused: an ID in the address isn't a UUID. Don't send it again unchanged.

Unauthorized.description: Sign-in refused. Nothing was read or stored. SDV-AUT-001, SDV-AUT-003: get a new token and send once more; if refused again, stop and alert. SDV-AUT-005, SDV-AUT-006, SDV-AUT-007, SDV-SYS-006: the sign-in setup must be fixed first; keep the delivery and send it again after. A refused token also gets WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="<code>".

Forbidden.description: Signed in, but not allowed here. Nothing was read or stored. A person must fix it first (a person's sign-in was used; the tenant is suspended; the sending system is paused or not the tenant's); keep the delivery and send it again after.

NoSuchSubmission.description: Refused: no submission of this sending system has this ID (or sourceSubmissionId). Don't send it again unchanged; create the submission first, or check the ID.

NotAcceptable.description: The Accept header asks for a format Vero can't answer in. Vero finds this only when it writes the answer, so the work may already be done (a submission created, a document stored). Send the same request again with Accept application/json (or */*, or no Accept header): a create or an upload is then answered 200 as already received.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Refused: the body's Content-Type isn't the one this operation takes. Nothing was stored. Don't send it again unchanged.

TooManyRequestsFromGateway.description: Vero itself never answers 429; when it is too busy it answers 503 SDV-SYS-018 with Retry-After. A gateway or proxy in front of Vero may answer 429. Wait (Retry-After, when given) and send the same request again.

ServerFailure.description: Failed inside Vero. SDV-SYS-013: send it again later. SDV-SYS-016: Vero found an inconsistency; send it again once Vero's IT team has looked at the reference.

ServerFailureWithAudit.description: Failed inside Vero; nothing was stored or changed. SDV-SYS-013 and SDV-SYS-017 (the audit couldn't be written, so nothing was done): send it again later. SDV-SYS-016: send it again once Vero's IT team has looked at the reference.

Unavailable.description: Vero can't take the request right now. Send the same request again. SDV-SYS-018: Vero is busy; wait the seconds in the Retry-After header first. Every other code here means unavailable and has no Retry-After; wait with back-off (check readiness): SDV-SYS-001, SDV-SYS-002: Vero's database is being upgraded. SDV-SYS-014: the database can't be reached. SDV-AUT-004: the sign-in server's keys can't be fetched.

x-sdv-retry.yes: Vero couldn't do it now. Wait and send exactly the same request again. If the answer has a Retry-After header (only the busy answer, 503 SDV-SYS-018), wait that many seconds. Otherwise back off (for example 2 s doubling to at most 5 minutes; check readiness). It is safe: a retry of a create or an upload is never stored twice.
x-sdv-retry.new-token: The token was missing, expired or not accepted. Get a new token and send the same request once more. If it is refused again, stop and alert: the sign-in setup is wrong.
x-sdv-retry.no: A refusal. Sending the same request again gets the same answer. Correct what the message names, or drop it and alert.
x-sdv-retry.after-fix: A person must fix Vero's or the sign-in server's setup first. Keep the delivery, alert, and send it again after the fix.

401 SDV-AUT-003.summary: Token expired, not yet valid, badly signed, for another issuer or audience, too long-lived, or not a JWT.

401 SDV-AUT-005.summary: A claim Vero needs is missing or not usable (sub, tenant ID, source ID), or the token has both the source-ID and the groups claim.

401 SDV-AUT-006.summary: The token has no source-ID claim, so it was read as a person's, and Vero has no active sign-in connection for its issuer.

401 SDV-AUT-007.summary: The token has no source-ID claim, so it was read as a person's, and it gives no Vero role.

401 SDV-SYS-006.summary: Sign-in is switched off in this Vero.

403 SDV-AUT-002.summary: A person's sign-in on a sending system's address.

403 SDV-AUT-009.summary: The tenant doesn't exist in Vero or is suspended.

403 SDV-INT-005.summary: The sending system isn't one of the tenant's, or Tenant IT paused it.

400 SDV-INT-006.summary: Submission incomplete: no body, expectedDocumentCount below 1, sourceSubmissionId missing or longer than 200.

400 SDV-INT-007.summary: Document list not valid: over the limit, more entries than the count, an entry missing, too long or twice.

400 SDV-INT-008.summary: A metadata field unknown, missing, blank, null, or not a single value.

400 SDV-INT-009.summary: A metadata value of the wrong type or breaking its field's rule.

400 SDV-SEN-002.summary: recordSensitivityLevel is not exactly one of the three names.

400 SDV-SEN-006.summary: sensitivityLevel on the submission; it belongs on each upload.

400 SDV-SYS-015.summary: The request couldn't be read: JSON that doesn't parse, an ID that isn't a UUID, a required header or parameter missing.

400 SDV-SEN-001.summary: X-SDV-Sensitivity-Level is not exactly one of the three names.

400 SDV-INT-012.summary: The upload has no identity, or its X-SDV-Source-Document-Id isn't in the submission's complete list.

400 SDV-INT-013.summary: An upload header isn't valid: file name blank, too long or a path; an ID longer than 200.

400 SDV-INT-015.summary: The body is empty, cut short, or not a PDF.

400 SDV-INT-016.summary: The document would take the submission over its total size limit. Send it on a new submission.

404 SDV-INT-004.summary: No submission of this sending system has this ID.

404 SDV-INT-018.summary: No document of this submission has this ID.

406 SDV-SYS-015.summary: The Accept header asks for a format Vero can't answer in. The work may already be done; send again with Accept application/json.

409 SDV-INT-011.summary: A submission with this sourceSubmissionId exists with a different body.

409 SDV-SEN-004.summary: A submission with this sourceSubmissionId exists with another recordSensitivityLevel.

409 SDV-INT-016.summary: The submission already has all its documents. Send it on a new submission.

409 SDV-INT-017.summary: A document with this identity is already stored with other content or file name.

409 SDV-SEN-003.summary: A document with this identity is already stored with another level.

409 SDV-INT-018.summary: The document can't be finished again in its state.

413 SDV-INT-014.summary: The PDF is over the size limit.

415 SDV-SYS-015.summary: The body's Content-Type isn't the one this operation takes.

500 SDV-SYS-016.summary: An internal check failed; retrying usually gives the same answer.

500 SDV-SYS-017.summary: The audit couldn't be written, so nothing was done.

500 SDV-INT-010.summary: Tenant IT's rule for a metadata field is broken.

503 SDV-SYS-001.summary: Vero's database is older than Vero (upgrade under way).

503 SDV-SYS-002.summary: Vero's database is newer than Vero.

503 SDV-SYS-018.summary: Vero is busy: no database connection is free for the request. Wait the seconds in the Retry-After header and send the same request again.

503 SDV-AUT-004.summary: The sign-in server's keys can't be fetched.

503 SDV-STO-001.summary: No storage can take the document (storage full).

503 SDV-STO-004.summary: Storage for this tenant isn't available: the storage volume Vero picked names a storage provider this install doesn't have. The installer must fix it.

x-sdv-compatibility.policy: docs/api/README.md, 'Versioning'. Within /v1 Vero only adds: new optional request fields, new answer fields, new codes. Ignore answer fields you don't know, and treat an unknown code by its status and the x-sdv-retry of the status class (4xx: no; 503: yes).
x-sdv-compatibility.producerIsolation: No shared Vero code, schema, database, internal IDs or runtime dependency is required.
